The user asks: "这部分事实构成什么罪名？一行作答。" They provide a scenario: In Dec 2011, defendant Sha (沙某某) was entrusted by victim Du (杜某某) to deposit 150,000 RMB in Shanghai bank under Sha's name and give the deposit slip to Du. Then Sha, without Du's knowledge, reported the deposit slip lost, got a replacement, and used the replacement to withdraw all the money for personal use.

We need to identify the crime under Chinese criminal law. This is essentially embezzlement (挪用公款?) No, it's not public funds. It's private funds entrusted to him. He misappropriated money entrusted to him. That is "诈骗罪"? Actually fraud is obtaining property by deception. Here he was entrusted with money, then he misappropriated it. That is "侵占罪" (embezzlement of property). Under Chinese law, "侵占罪" is for misappropriation of property that one has custody of. Also "挪用" is for public funds. So the correct crime is "侵占罪". Also could be "诈骗罪"? He didn't deceive to get the money; he just misappropriated after being entrusted. So it's "侵占罪". The answer format: {"final_answer": "[罪名]侵占罪<eoa>"}.

Make sure to follow format exactly: {"final_answer": "[罪名]侵占罪<eoa>"}.
